title.de: I wish I had, if only · Wünsche und Bedauern
title.it: I wish I had, if only · Desideri e rimpianti
title.en: I wish I had, if only · Wishes and regrets

description.sl: Kar zdaj ni tako: I wish I had a dog. Kar obžaluješ: I wish I'd listened. Kar te moti: I wish you would stop. Močneje: if only. Takrat in zdaj: If I'd listened, I'd be there now.
description.de: Was jetzt nicht so ist: I wish I had a dog. Was du bereust: I wish I'd listened. Was dich stört: I wish you would stop. Stärker: if only. Damals und jetzt: If I'd listened, I'd be there now.
description.it: Ciò che ora non è così: I wish I had a dog. Ciò che rimpiangi: I wish I'd listened. Ciò che ti dà fastidio: I wish you would stop. Più forte: if only. Allora e adesso: If I'd listened, I'd be there now.
description.en: What isn't so now: I wish I had a dog. What you regret: I wish I'd listened. What annoys you: I wish you would stop. Stronger: if only. Then and now: If I'd listened, I'd be there now.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

story.sl: Old Wilf knows a hundred stories. "I wish I'd written them down," he says. "If only my hands were steadier!" · Old Wilf pozna sto zgodb. »Škoda, da jih nisem zapisal,« pravi. »Ko bi le imel bolj mirne roke!«
story.de: Old Wilf knows a hundred stories. "I wish I'd written them down," he says. "If only my hands were steadier!" · Old Wilf kennt hundert Geschichten. »Ich wünschte, ich hätte sie aufgeschrieben«, sagt er. »Wenn meine Hände nur ruhiger wären!«
story.it: Old Wilf knows a hundred stories. "I wish I'd written them down," he says. "If only my hands were steadier!" · Old Wilf conosce cento storie. «Vorrei averle scritte», dice. «Se solo le mie mani fossero più ferme!»
story.en: Old Wilf knows a hundred stories. "I wish I'd written them down," he says. "If only my hands were steadier!"

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ a boat. Then I could row across the lake.

explain.sl:
**Kar zdaj ni tako: wish + preteklik**
- **I wish I had a boat.** · Ko bi le {m:imel|f:imela} čoln.
explain.de:
**Was jetzt nicht so ist: wish + past**
- **I wish I had a boat.** · Ich wünschte, ich hätte ein Boot.
explain.it:
**Ciò che ora non è così: wish + past**
- **I wish I had a boat.** · Vorrei avere una barca.
explain.en:
**What isn't so now: wish + the past**
- **I wish I had a boat.**

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ to my father when I was young.

explain.sl:
**Kar obžaluješ iz preteklosti: wish + had + deležnik**
- **I wish I'd listened.** · Škoda, da nisem {m:poslušal|f:poslušala}.
explain.de:
**Was du von damals bereust: wish + had + Partizip**
- **I wish I'd listened.** · Ich wünschte, ich hätte zugehört.
explain.it:
**Ciò che rimpiangi di allora: wish + had + participio**
- **I wish I'd listened.** · Vorrei aver ascoltato.
explain.en:
**What you regret about then: wish + had + the participle**
- **I wish I'd listened.**

exercises.prompt: I wish it ___ raining! I want to go out.

explain.sl:
**Želiš, da bi nekaj ali nekdo nekaj naredil: wish + would. Kar se še lahko zgodi: hope**
- **I wish it would stop raining.** · Ko bi le nehalo deževati.
- **I hope it stops.** · Upam, da bo nehalo.
explain.de:
**Du willst, dass etwas oder jemand etwas tut: wish + would. Was noch passieren kann: hope**
- **I wish it would stop raining.** · Wenn es doch nur aufhören würde zu regnen.
- **I hope it stops.** · Ich hoffe, es hört auf.
explain.it:
**Vuoi che qualcosa o qualcuno faccia qualcosa: wish + would. Ciò che può ancora succedere: hope**
- **I wish it would stop raining.** · Se solo smettesse di piovere.
- **I hope it stops.** · Spero che smetta.
explain.en:
**You want something or someone to do it: wish + would. What may still happen: hope**
- **I wish it would stop raining.**
- **I hope it stops.**

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?
instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

options: I wish I had a dog.
I wish I would have a dog.

explain.sl:
**Zdaj: wish + preteklik ali could. Takrat: wish + had + deležnik. Kar te moti: wish + would**
- **I wish I could swim.** · Ko bi le {m:znal|f:znala} plavati.
- **If only I knew!** · Ko bi le {m:vedel|f:vedela}!
explain.de:
**Jetzt: wish + past oder could. Damals: wish + had + Partizip. Was dich stört: wish + would**
- **I wish I could swim.** · Ich wünschte, ich könnte schwimmen.
- **If only I knew!** · Wenn ich es nur wüsste!
explain.it:
**Ora: wish + past o could. Allora: wish + had + participio. Ciò che ti dà fastidio: wish + would**
- **I wish I could swim.** · Vorrei saper nuotare.
- **If only I knew!** · Se solo lo sapessi!
explain.en:
**Now: wish + the past or could. Then: wish + had + the participle. What annoys you: wish + would**
- **I wish I could swim.**
- **If only I knew!**

- **I wish I could swim.** · Ko bi le {m:znal|f:znala} plavati.
explain.de:
**Was du jetzt nicht kannst: wish + could**
- **I wish I could swim.** · Ich wünschte, ich könnte schwimmen.
explain.it:
**Ciò che ora non sai fare: wish + could**
- **I wish I could swim.** · Vorrei saper nuotare.
explain.en:

- **I wish I could swim.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Škoda, da sem {m:prodal|f:prodala} staro kolo.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Ich wünschte, ich hätte mein altes Fahrrad nicht verkauft.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Vorrei non aver venduto la mia vecchia bici.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: I wish I hadn't sold my old bike.

exercises.text: I wish I ___ (not sell) my old bike.
accept: hadn't sold
had not sold

hint.de: Es ist verkauft, und du bereust es.
hint.it: È venduta, e te ne penti.
hint.en: It's sold, and you regret it.

explain.sl:
**Obžaluješ, kar se je zgodilo: wish + hadn't + deležnik**
- **I wish I hadn't sold it.** · Škoda, da sem ga {m:prodal|f:prodala}.
explain.de:
**Du bereust, was geschehen ist: wish + hadn't + Partizip**
- **I wish I hadn't sold it.** · Ich wünschte, ich hätte es nicht verkauft.
explain.it:
**Rimpiangi ciò che è successo: wish + hadn't + participio**
- **I wish I hadn't sold it.** · Vorrei non averla venduta.
explain.en:
**You regret what happened: wish + hadn't + the participle**
- **I wish I hadn't sold it.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Če bi {m:poslušal|f:poslušala} vremensko napoved, zdaj ne bi {m:bil moker|f:bila mokra}.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Wenn ich auf den Wetterbericht gehört hätte, wäre ich jetzt nicht nass.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Se avessi ascoltato le previsioni, ora non sarei bagnat{m:o|f:a}.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: If I'd listened to the forecast, I wouldn't be wet now.

exercises.text: If I'd listened to the forecast, I ___ (not be) wet now.
accept: wouldn't be
would not be

hint.sl: Takrat se je zgodilo, posledica je zdaj.
hint.de: Damals geschehen, die Folge ist jetzt.
hint.it: È successo allora, la conseguenza è adesso.
hint.en: It happened then; the result is now.

explain.sl:
**Takrat in zdaj: if + had + deležnik, nato would + osnovna oblika**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be wet now.** · Če bi {m:poslušal|f:poslušala}, zdaj ne bi {m:bil moker|f:bila mokra}.
explain.de:
**Damals und jetzt: if + had + Partizip, dann would + Grundform**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be wet now.** · Wenn ich zugehört hätte, wäre ich jetzt nicht nass.
explain.it:
**Allora e adesso: if + had + participio, poi would + forma base**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be wet now.** · Se avessi ascoltato, ora non sarei bagnat{m:o|f:a}.
explain.en:
**Then and now: if + had + the participle, then would + the base form**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be wet now.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Če bi Wilf šel z avtobusom, bi bil zdaj že doma.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Wenn Wilf den Bus genommen hätte, wäre er jetzt schon zu Hause.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Se Wilf avesse preso l'autobus, ora sarebbe già a casa.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: If Wilf had taken the bus, he'd be home by now.

exercises.text: If Wilf ___ (take) the bus, he'd be home by now.
accept: had taken
'd taken

hint.sl: Avtobusa ni vzel; posledica je zdaj.
hint.de: Er hat den Bus nicht genommen; die Folge ist jetzt.
hint.it: Non ha preso l'autobus; la conseguenza è adesso.
hint.en: He didn't take the bus; the result is now.

explain.sl:
**Kar se takrat ni zgodilo: if + had + deležnik (take, took, taken)**
- **If he'd taken the bus, he'd be home.** · Če bi šel z avtobusom, bi bil doma.
explain.de:
**Was damals nicht geschah: if + had + Partizip (take, took, taken)**
- **If he'd taken the bus, he'd be home.** · Wenn er den Bus genommen hätte, wäre er zu Hause.
explain.it:
**Ciò che allora non è successo: if + had + participio (take, took, taken)**
- **If he'd taken the bus, he'd be home.** · Se avesse preso l'autobus, sarebbe a casa.
explain.en:
**What didn't happen then: if + had + the participle (take, took, taken)**
- **If he'd taken the bus, he'd be home.**

explain.de:
**Damals: if + had + Partizip. Jetzt: wouldn't + Grundform**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be lost now.** · Wenn ich zugehört hätte, hätte ich mich jetzt nicht verlaufen.
explain.it:
**Allora: if + had + participio. Adesso: wouldn't + forma base**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be lost now.** · Se avessi ascoltato, ora non sarei pers{m:o|f:a}.
explain.en:
**Then: if + had + the participle. Now: wouldn't + the base form**
- **If I'd listened, I wouldn't be lost now.**
